description: This file contains Jetpack Compose UI components for chat message rendering in an Android application. It defines composable functions for displaying chat bubbles, message content like text and images, typing indicators, tool call bubbles, and code blocks, all styled with custom UI theming.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class encapsulating style properties for chat bubbles, including alignment, container color, border color, and role label color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable displaying a chat message bubble, filtering content parts and applying style based on role.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Provides the container UI for a chat bubble with role label and styling.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the content parts of a chat message, either text or base64 images.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Shows a typing indicator bubble with animated dots.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Displays a bubble indicating that tools are running, showing a list of active tools.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a live streaming message bubble from the assistant.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Returns style properties for a bubble based on role type.

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Determines label text based on role string.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Renders an image from a base64 string, with fallback message if loading fails.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Displays animated pulsing dots for typing indicator.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a code block with optional language label and syntax styling.
